description: Boletín hidrológico de los embalses de Galicia-Costa is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Xunta de Galicia. Informe do estado dos recursos hídricos dos encoros da demarcación Galicia-Costa con datos relativos ao volume total, volume encorado, ocupación, resgardo, observacións... Tamén pode consultarse o histórico dos boletíns que se xeran, semanalmente, desde 2005. Coverage: Xunta de Galicia. The portal shows the English title as "Boletín hidrolóxico dos encoros de Galicia-Costa" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Xunta de Galicia. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2026-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/deed.gl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
